item.title: Your Static Site Build Should Not Rewrite Every Page
item.description: A static site build that rewrites every page creates noisy deployments. Here's why deterministic output matters and how to keep generated files under control.

item.title: The Typo That Silently Breaks Your Static Site (And How to Catch It)
item.description: A wrong frontmatter key in your static site generator won't throw an error — it will just silently do nothing. Here's the story of a missing blog image and what it teaches about debugging config-driven systems.
